title: defs.v1
description: Shared types for every contract (spec 5.1, 5.3, 6.1, 6.3). Not a message: message schemas $ref these with a relative path, e.g. ../../common/defs.v1.schema.json#/$defs/Amount. Only additive changes within v1.

SchemaVersion.description: Major version of a message schema, mirrored in the mw-schema-version header (spec 6.1). Each message schema pins it with const.

TxnId.description: UUIDv7, lower case, minted by the middleware at first contact (spec 5.1).

CorrelationId.description: Propagated across all hops (X-Correlation-Id, Kafka header mw-correlation-id).

IdempotencyKey.description: From the channel (Idempotency-Key header) or derived (spec 7.3).

CommandId.description: txnId + step + attempt-independent suffix (spec 7.3); the core is idempotent on it.

Amount.description: Money on the wire: integer minor units (poisha), never a decimal (spec 5.1).

Msisdn.description: Bangladeshi mobile number, with or without the 880 country code.

Party.description: Who pays or receives (spec 5.1). Card numbers never appear; only tokens (SEC-02).

EncryptedPin.description: PIN encrypted with the core's public key keyId (RSA-OAEP, SHA-256); the middleware never decrypts it (spec 6.3).
